outfits.o1: sticking plasters on his head and cheek and a bandage on one flipper
outfits.o2: sticking plasters on her head and arm

s1.desc: a sunny lawn in front of an ice cream shop with a green door and round hanging lamps, softly blurred

s2.desc: a sunny park lawn with round cafe tables and striped parasols below a rose-coloured hill with a round arch

spans.notes: Pax on a crutch at the park cafe; the camera tracks sideways the whole shot (background shifts 6-15 px/frame at 540 wide, with a jolt around f41-44 and f57-58)

spans.view: with a round turquoise table in the foreground

beats.text: Polly stands holding two ice cream cones against her chest and looks down with a soft, wistful face
Polly turns her head to face ahead and opens her beak with a hopeful look
Polly tears up and spreads her flippers a little, a cone in each

spans.notes: shop facade feature-matched static over f69-99 (v4 called the whole shot a push-in; the move only starts at f100). Background is drawn soft-focus.
camera follows Polly as she turns and waddles off to the left licking a cone

spans.view: with little round stools on the grass behind them

beats.text: Pax hobbles in from the left on his crutch while Polly waddles in from the right holding out two ice cream cones
Polly hands Pax a green ice cream cone and he takes it in his bandaged flipper
Polly throws her flippers around Pax and hugs him tight, both with their eyes closed, cheek to cheek
Polly lets go and steps back while Pax holds his cone
Pax wipes a tear from his eye with his flipper, eyes squeezed shut, while Polly watches him with a worried face
Pax lowers his flipper and looks at Polly with wide eyes while she looks back, holding her cone
Pax and Polly stand holding their ice cream cones and gaze at each other
Polly leans in with her eyes closed and clinks her ice cream cone against the cone in Pax's flipper
Polly straightens up and the two stand holding their cones, looking at each other
